scripts.build: npm run build -w @darkseek/sdk && npm run build -w @darkseek/indexer
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @darkseek/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:program: cargo test --manifest-path programs/darkseek-vault/Cargo.toml --lib && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/source.test.ts tests/timelocks.test.ts tests/protocol.test.ts tests/token.test.ts
